minecraft:written_book_content.title: As Above
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Minecraft
pages:
This mysterious structure has something off about it.

Its portal has been unlit for a long time, and wherever this portal went has since been long forgotten, if it even worked in the first place.

How could it have ever been lit to begin with, in this hellish place? Maybe this world wasn’t always like this.

It really makes you wonder…

Where did this portal lead?
